Aster consumes [[600]] Energy to target [[1]] tile, summoning a Star to deal [[360%]]<ATK> damage to enemies within [[1]] tile.
He then supercharges all of his Stars, causing each Star to deal [[240%]]<ATK> damage to enemies within [[1]] tile and stun them for [[2]]s. Supercharged Stars burn for [[6]]s, dealing [[36%]]<ATK> damage per second to enemies within [[1]] tile.
Up to [[3]] of Aster's Stars can exist on the battlefield at the same time. If this limit is reached, summoning a new Star replaces the oldest Star with the fewest enemies in range.
Only [[1]] of Aster's own Stars can exist on each tile. When cast automatically, this skill prioritizes tiles with the most enemies that do not overlap with any of his other Stars.
Increases the damage dealt when a Star is supercharged to [[270%]]<ATK>, and its burn damage to [[42%]]<ATK> per second.
Increases the damage dealt when a Star is supercharged to [[300%]]<ATK>, and its burn damage to [[48%]]<ATK> per second.
Increases the damage dealt when a Star is supercharged to [[330%]]<ATK>, and its burn damage to [[54%]]<ATK> per second.
Increases the damage dealt when a Star is supercharged to [[360%]]<ATK>, and its burn damage to [[60%]]<ATK> per second.

Passive. Whenever Aster summons a Star, [[1]] Planet is created on an adjacent tile, prioritizing the tile occupied by the adjacent enemy with the lowest HP. This deals [[120%]]<ATK> damage to the enemy on that tile.
Each Planet orbits its Star once every [[6]]s, dealing [[90%]]<ATK> damage to enemies it collides with. An enemy can take this damage [[1]] time every [[3]]s. Whenever a Planet completes an orbit, it deals [[180%]]<ATK> damage to enemies on the central tile.
Active. Aster commands all his Stars and Black Holes on the battlefield, pulling enemies within [[2]] tiles of them toward the nearest Star or Black Hole and dealing [[270%]]<ATK> damage.
Increases the pull damage to [[300%]]<ATK>.
Increases the pull damage to [[330%]]<ATK>.
Increases the pull damage to [[360%]]<ATK>.

Aster fires pulse beams along [[3]] lines that cover the most enemies, dealing [[210%]]<ATK> damage to enemies hit. He also gains a shield equal to [[90%]] of the total actual damage dealt by this skill. The shield lasts [[9]]s. Each time a pulse beam hits an enemy, it also reduces the target's shield value by up to [[270%]]<ATK>.
Increases damage dealt to [[240%]]<ATK> and shield value reduction to [[300%]]<ATK>.
Increases damage dealt to [[270%]]<ATK> and shield value reduction to [[330%]]<ATK>.
Increases damage dealt to [[300%]]<ATK> and shield value reduction to [[360%]]<ATK>.

Aster increases his ATK by [[2%]] during battle. Whenever he summons a Star, his ATK increases by an extra [[2%]], up to [[6%]]. After converting Stars into Black Holes, his ATK increases further by [[6%]].

Aster increases his ATK by [[4%]] during battle. Whenever he summons a Star, his ATK increases by an extra [[4%]], up to [[12%]]. After converting Stars into Black Holes, his ATK increases further by [[9%]].

Aster increases his ATK by [[6%]] during battle. Whenever he summons a Star, his ATK increases by an extra [[6%]], up to [[18%]]. After converting Stars into Black Holes, his ATK increases further by [[12%]].

Passive. After summoning [[3]] Stars, Aster permanently converts all his Stars into Black Holes and devours the Planets orbiting them.
From then on, Stars summoned through Stellar Flare are created directly as Black Holes. Initially, each Black Hole deals [[30%]]<ATK> true damage plus extra true damage equal to [[2%]] of the target's max HP to enemies within [[1]] tile every second. The total damage cannot exceed [[60%]]<ATK>.
When supercharged by Stellar Flare, Black Holes do not burn. Instead, each Black Hole drains [[30%]] ATK and [[30]] Haste from every enemy within range. The ATK drained increases the damage of all Black Holes, while the Haste drained increases the frequency at which they deal continuous damage. These increases cannot exceed [[60%]] and [[60%]], respectively. The cumulative ATK a single enemy can lose through this effect cannot exceed [[60%]] of Aster's initial ATK.
Increases the true damage dealt by Black Holes to enemies within range to [[60%]]<ATK> plus [[4%]] of the target's max HP. The total damage cannot exceed [[120%]]<ATK>.
Increases the true damage dealt by Black Holes to enemies within range to [[90%]]<ATK> plus [[6%]] of the target's max HP. The total damage cannot exceed [[180%]]<ATK>.

When a Black Hole is supercharged by Stellar Flare, it deals [[180%]]<ATK> extra true damage to enemies within range. When an enemy hero is defeated within a Black Hole's range, that Black Hole devours them and restores [[333]] Energy to Aster.
